lcc_original: 瑪勒列活到六十五歲，生了雅列。
notes: LCC text is identical to UNV for this verse, so all alignments are direct 1:1 mappings.
WH08141 (שָׁנָה/שָׁנִים) appears twice because Hebrew expresses '65 years' as 'five year(s) and sixty year' — first instance attached to 六十, second to 歲.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: Hebrew direct object marker אֵת has no Chinese equivalent in LCC just as in UNV.
